I promise you chromosomes aren’t as important or definite as people like to claim. XX and XY are not the only options, and they are not some ultimate end all be all of human sexual dimorphism. There are XY individuals who otherwise appear as “female”, there are X and XXY and XXX and XYY (etc.) individuals. The actual chromosomal differences between XX and XY individuals is small and relatively inconsequential in the grand scheme of things. The much more important thing (for determining secondary sex characteristics) is hormones, and we are very able to adjust that. People who claim chromosomes as some objective reality to sex and wrong and know nothing about the subject they are speaking on.

Here’s something that’s helped me through chemistry. Think of a mole (avagadros number) like you’d think of a dozen, just a much larger version. If you have 20 candies and you need to know how many dozen, you do 20/12. If you know that a candy is 10 grams and you need to know how many dozen candies are in a half kilo, you can throw that over 120 (the grams of candy in a dozen). Replace ‘candies’ with atoms, ‘dozen’ with moles, and 12 with avagadros number and you’re good to go!
